Messages.Author: Kulaid
Messages.Body:
How many corruption counter will it take to take control of a
shambling horde?

I would think it would be similiar to khobar towers? Where cost means
the pool cost? Or do you need 3 corruption counters to take control
of it?

Messages.Author: Colin McGuigan
Messages.Body:


For Khobar Towers, cost is pool *or* blood (a reversal of a previous
ruling, so check your dates...)

http://groups.google.com/groups?selm=3CD0043D.410398C1%40white-wolf.com
http://groups.google.com/groups?selm=3E37C9BF.F817510B%40white-wolf.com

So I'd assume that it'd be the same for Corruption: it would take 3
counters.

(Note that the hordes can't be taken via Form of Corruption or Temptation)

--Colin McGuigan
